annotationRationale: Floor values define exact logarithmic intervals. Independent uniform coordinates turn matching intervals into disjoint squares, and their areas form a convergent geometric series. Logarithmic monotonicity supports the interval conversion.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution using square regions in the unit square and an infinite geometric series, with coverage, disjointness, and boundary handling made explicit.

review.mathCheck: For each positive n, floor value −n corresponds exactly to \([2^{-n},2^{1-n})\). Independent matching coordinates therefore contribute probability \(4^{-n}\). These disjoint cases exhaust the event, and their sum is \((1/4)/(1-1/4)=1/3\), choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: An originally worded, faithful adaptation of MAA #20's first approach. Its matching squares agree with the supplied diagram, and the explanation establishes their dimensions without requiring that figure.
review.annotationCheck: The D key and method annotation agree. Negative floors, dyadic endpoints, the open sampling domain, disjointness and convergence are correctly handled.
